text:
maria (Design): quick sync — putting up a small design change proposal for the embeddings preview table: allow inline row edits (change label, score override) and keyboard-first nav. dropping the fig in thread. :eyes:

sam (PM): love the idea. primary ask: how does this affect copy for exports and audit logs? we need clear traceability for overrides.

alex (Eng): implementation note: inline edit as a contenteditable feels risky. prefer a focused input that appears in place. focus management + `role="row"` updates needed. can prototype with `tabindex=0` on row cells.

louise (A11y): accessibility nits: screen reader should announce "editing" state when an input appears. use `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-describedby` for validation messages. also ensure keyboard trap is avoided when opening inline editor.

maria (Design): good call. thinking: show a tiny pill next to edited rows "manual override" with timestamp and user initials. on hover show `View reason` tooltip. copy on export should include a column `override_reason`.

devin (Product): +1. for CSV export we need stable column ordering. sample CSV header we'd expect: ```id,text,embedding_128,score,override_flag,override_reason,edited_by,edited_at``` also: if user cancels edit, no row should be marked.

alex (Eng): re: CSV, we should flatten embedding vectors or provide a separate .npz download option. flattening 128 dims into separate columns is messy. maybe add a toggle in export modal: "Embed columns" vs "Single vector blob (.npy)".

louise (A11y): small keyboard flow nit: when you press Enter to commit an edit, focus should move to the next logical cell (right or next row). hitting Esc should undo and return focus to the original cell. document these behaviors in the component docs.

maria (Design): UX question: inline help for score overrides — should we show an inline microcopy under the score input: "Use only to correct mis-ranks. Prefer rerank rules for bulk changes"?

sam (PM): yes, short microcopy is fine. also add a link to a support doc for "When to override vs rerank". keep it one sentence.

alex (Eng): technical detail for reviewers: avoid re-rendering the whole table on every keystroke. debounce 300ms and send updates only on commit for audit log. live validation can be local.

maria (Design): design follow-ups: 1) visual for override pill; 2) keyboard map in the table header (tooltip); 3) export modal copy update. assigning mockups to me.

devin (Product): timeline: can we get a tiny A/B test for the pill visibility? show pill in 50% to measure if people spot manual edits in exports.

louise (A11y): accessibility test plan: NVDA/VoiceOver pass for edit flow + keyboard-only walkthrough, plus an automated axe scan for focus order.

ui-bot: Screenshot uploaded — /uploads/inline-edit-rows-v2.png

maria (Design): thanks — I'll push a new figma link by EOD and include copy variants for microcopy. tagging @sam for export wording review. :thumbsup:

sam (PM): got it, will review exports copy after figma updates. if no major dev blockers, target a small rollout to staging next week.

alex (Eng): noted. I'll prototype focus/aria changes and share a PR with storybook examples.

louise (A11y): adding the A11y checklist to the PR description will speed reviews.

maria (Design): cool — keeping this thread for any quick nits. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
